messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] GGIR - axivity analysis
parts:
Hi Marco,

I have just uploaded a new GGIRread release 0.2.8 to CRAN which should address the problems we have been seeing since it's release 0.2.7 last week.

It usually takes a couple of days for the binaries to become available for each operating systems, but hopefully you can install it after the weekend.

Would you mind installing this and trying again?

If that does not address the issue then please share:
  • R script
  • Whether the file looks plausible on OMGUI
  • Whether you have this problem with other files.
  • Whether you have this problem on other computers

Thanks,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
